description: This file extends table select functionality for the Claro theme in Drupal, implementing bulk actions and sticky behavior for table rows and checkboxes.

classes.name: Drupal.ClaroBulkActions
classes.description: Class managing bulk actions and sticky table row behavior in Drupal's Claro theme.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes bulk actions, event handlers, and manages spacer CSS for sticky table rows.

methods.name: blurHandler
methods.description: Handles focus loss on table rows to remove focus spacers.

methods.name: focusHandler
methods.description: Ensures partially covered elements are scrolled into full view when focused.

methods.name: scrollResizeHandler
methods.description: Hides spacers during scroll/resize and re-shows them after a delay.

methods.name: underStickyHandler
methods.description: Adjusts focusable elements and spacers for sticky table rows.

methods.name: rowCheckboxHandler
methods.description: Updates bulk actions status when individual checkboxes are toggled.

methods.name: updateStatus
methods.description: Updates bulk actions label and announces selection count.
